delete_file.description: Permanently delete a file you uploaded. Its link stops working at once. A file that is already gone counts as deleted.
delete_file.display_str_template: Delete the Upload to URL file {0}.
delete_file.name: delete_file

parameters.description: The file to delete: the file_id 'Upload a file' returned.
parameters.name: file_id

filename.description: The name the deleted file was hosted under.

note.description: Says so when the file was already gone. Empty otherwise.

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

get_file.description: Look up a file you uploaded: its public link, name, size, and when it expires.
get_file.display_str_template: Get the Upload to URL file {0}.
get_file.name: get_file

parameters.description: The file to look up: the file_id 'Upload a file' returned.
parameters.name: file_id

content_type.description: The file's media type, e.g. application/pdf.

expired.description: True once the link has stopped working.

expires_at.description: When the link stops working and the file is deleted (ISO 8601). Empty when it never expires.

file_id.description: The file's ID, for 'Get a file' and 'Delete a file'.

filename.description: The name the file is hosted under.

size_bytes.description: Size of the file in bytes.

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

url.description: The file's public link, to share, embed or send.

publish_web_page.description: Turn HTML into a live web page with its own public link, such as an email preview, a report or a landing page.
publish_web_page.display_str_template: Publish a web page with Upload to URL.
publish_web_page.name: publish_web_page

parameters.description: Optional. The end of the page's link: spring-menu publishes at uploadtourl.com/spring-menu. Leave blank for a new address each time.
parameters.name: page_address

parameters.description: How long the link keeps working before Upload to URL deletes the file. Your plan's default is 7 days on Free, 90 on Starter and a year on Pro. Free keeps files for up to 7 days; paid plans can keep them longer, or never delete them.
parameters.name: delete_after

page_address.description: The end of the page's link, e.g. spring-menu.

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

uploads_left.description: How many uploads the account has left this month.

upload_file.description: Upload any file and get a public link to share, embed or send. Choose a file, use one from an earlier step, or paste a link.
upload_file.name: upload_file

parameters.description: The file to host: upload one, pick one from an earlier step, or paste a public link to it.
parameters.name: file

parameters.description: How long the link keeps working before Upload to URL deletes the file. Your plan's default is 7 days on Free, 90 on Starter and a year on Pro. Free keeps files for up to 7 days; paid plans can keep them longer, or never delete them.
parameters.name: delete_after

parameters.description: Optional. The file name to host it under, which also ends its link, e.g. menu.pdf. Leave blank to keep the file's own name.
parameters.name: save_as

content_type.description: The file's media type, e.g. application/pdf.

expires_at.description: When the link stops working and the file is deleted (ISO 8601). Empty when it never expires.

file_id.description: The file's ID, for 'Get a file' and 'Delete a file'.

filename.description: The name the file is hosted under.

note.description: A sentence when something differs from what was asked, such as the plan keeping the file for less time. Empty otherwise.

size_bytes.description: Size of the file in bytes.

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

uploads_left.description: How many uploads the account has left this month.

url.description: The file's public link, to share, embed or send.

description: Get a public link for any file with Upload to URL: host images, PDFs, videos and documents, choose how long each link lasts, and publish HTML as a web page.
